review_dispositions.repository_truth: Existing modular/static OBJ character pieces are prototype/static fallback only. Final animated delivery is already FBX-only with real skeleton/skin/deformation/AnimBP requirements.
review_dispositions.action: Continue the existing Frodo/Gandalf/Sam skeletal candidate/intake lane; do not fake-rig or container-convert OBJ assets.
review_dispositions.runtime_gate: Character presentation remains separately UE-import/PIE/device gated.

review_dispositions.repository_truth: Current P1C01 low-spec material wave intentionally uses one albedo texture plus authored scalar Roughness/Metallic/Specular. Normal/AO/Roughness/Metallic textures are known future inputs but extra texture samples are explicitly blocked before target-device measurement.
review_dispositions.action: Prepare PBR upgrades as optional measured variants. Prefer a normal map plus channel-packed AO/Roughness/Metallic texture when evidence shows visual gain within the ~2 GB VRAM budget; never add separate high-resolution maps blindly.
review_dispositions.runtime_gate: No PBR sample-count increase before target-device/profile evidence.

review_dispositions.repository_truth: ShirePrototypeWorldBuilder already owns multiple HISM banks and explicit cull distances; FellowshipChapterWorldBuilder already uses WorldDetailCluster/HISM for dense micro-detail. Some small Shire decoration still goes through SpawnProd actor placement.
review_dispositions.action: After the living-world cull repair is exact-head engine-green, audit repeated non-interactive Shire SpawnProd detail and migrate eligible repeated fern/mushroom/decorative groups to HISM/WorldDetailCluster without moving story-critical collision actors.
review_dispositions.runtime_gate: Do not increase density while converting; preserve current counts/cull budgets first.

review_dispositions.repository_truth: ShireFootstepComponent already traces with bReturnPhysicalMaterial=true and consumes PhysMaterial identity, mesh/material names and tags, with dirt fallback.
review_dispositions.action: Prepare an authored surface-identity contract for grass/dirt/stone/wood and bind production Physical Materials during the next approved runtime/audio car. Keep the current heuristic fallback for un-authored surfaces.
review_dispositions.runtime_gate: No runtime footstep rewrite until the cull-repair exact-head engine gate is green.

review_dispositions.repository_truth: Current FellowshipMythicThreat Balrog presentation does not simulate a whip chain or PhysicsConstraint/CableComponent path. It uses bounded visual threat motion.
review_dispositions.action: If a whip is later promoted, use authored skeletal/spline/controlled visual animation or trails; do not create a many-body real-time physics chain on the target CPU.
review_dispositions.runtime_gate: Future Moria presentation work only; no current P1C01 runtime work.

permanent_guards: Animated production character delivery is FBX-only; OBJ remains static fallback/reference.
Production texture upgrades remain PNG/TGA and low-spec measured; prefer channel packing over independent AO/Roughness/Metallic textures.
Repeated non-interactive decorative detail uses HISM/ISM/WorldDetailCluster with LOD/culling where practical.
Footstep surface identity prefers authored Physical Materials while preserving a safe fallback.
No real-time multi-body Balrog whip chain on the target profile.
target_profile: 6th-gen i7 / 8 GB RAM / ~2 GB VRAM / DX11 / 1280x720 Low-Medium / 30 FPS floor target
evidence_boundary: STATIC SOURCE REVIEW + PREPARATION CONTRACT ONLY. No new runtime/PIE/device/visual/performance acceptance is claimed.
